Gen. Chukwuemeka Michael Akaliro, has called for stronger collaboration between the military and tertiary institutions in Taraba State to enhance security, promote peaceful coexistence and to ensure a conducive learning environment.
He made the call during visits to the Kwararafa University and Federal University Wukari as part of efforts to strengthen relations between the brigade and the academic institutions.
The commander said sustained engagement between the military and educational institutions was essential to promoting mutual understanding and addressing security concerns affecting communities.
He reaffirmed the Army’s commitment to supporting both institutions in matters relating to security, peace and peaceful coexistence, and stressed the importance of partnerships with key stakeholders in maintaining a safe academic environment.
Akaliro explained that the visits were part of his ongoing familiarisation tour since assuming command of the Brigade in Wukari.
He added that the relocation of the Brigade headquarters from Jalingo had created an opportunity to deepen engagement with institutions and other stakeholders in Wukari.
At Kwararafa University, the commander was received by the Vice-Chancellor, Prof. Shishi Zheme, and his management team, while Prof. Benjamin Kefas Ate of the Federal University Wukari, received the Brigade Commander.
In their separate remarks, the vice-chancellors commended the Nigerian Army for their contributions to maintaining peace and security in Taraba State and the country at large.
They expressed appreciation for the commander’s visits and pledged their institutions’ continued cooperation with the Brigade in advancing security, peaceful coexistence and community development.
